US Approves Large Arms Sale to Israel

The United States has approved a $2.8 billion arms sale to Israel, which includes 40,000 one-ton bombs. This pending transfer of munitions is described as one of the largest deliveries of U.S. munitions to Israel in years. The 2,000-pound bombs have been involved in incidents resulting in civilian casualties.
